title: Just OK
text: Just OK. This product is just OK in my mind. It seems sturdy enough to at least stack several boxes of shoes at a time. The box itself will hold one pair of shortish boots only, or 2 pairs of shoes. Unfortunately for me I would need a mountain of these to hold the shoes I have. Not sure what the price point on these is, but I think they aren't a really viable option for shoe storage.

product_metadata.title: InterDesign Aldo Fabric Storage Box for Shoes, Boots and Pumps with a Clear Window and Pull Tab Closure for Closet Storage – Large, Gray
features: SHOE BIN ORGANIZER – Large fabric organizer safely keeps shoes efficiently stored to maximize closet space; Wide capacity accommodates two pairs shoes or allows a pair of boots to neatly lie flat without folding
STACK THEM UP – Multiple bins can be stacked to create customized shoe storage in large or small closet spaces
SMART DESIGN – Clear window lets you see what's inside at a glance; Pull tab with two strong grip strips allow for easy access either from the top or the front
DURABLE – Reinforced fabric construction helps the bin protect stored pairs of shoes inside
SPACE-EFFICIENT – Compact design fits in small closet spaces; Measures 11.75" Inches x 14.50" Inches x 7" Inches
description: Keep your boots, pumps and other footwear neatly organized and easily accessible with InterDesign's Aldo Fabric Shoe Box. Featuring a reinforced, breathable fabric construction with a gray color scheme and a see-through window, finding the right pair of shoes has never been easier! The pull-tab door securely keeps your shoes enclosed and dust-free. The window lets you see what's inside and grab what you need even when multiple shoe bins are stacked.
